title: Low-Rank and Lifted Semidefinite Programming for Mixed-Integer Polynomial Power Grid Optimization
summary: Can a local solver return the guaranteed globally optimal solution to a nonconvex mixed-integer polynomial power grid optimization problem? By mixing low-rank semidefinite programming (SDP) and moment-based lifting in the Lasserre hierarchy, this paper provides anecdotal evidence in the affirmative. Specifically, we iteratively tighten a moment-based relaxation of the AC Optimal Transmission Switching (AC-OTS) problem, including higher order moment-based constraints, rooted in the Lasserre hierarchy, until it is tight (i.e., primal feasible).
